items.title: Intel’s 45% Downturn Over 3 Months Unsettles Investors: This Wall Street Analyst Predicts 155% Gains Anyway
items.summary: Intel just posted its best server quarter in 15 years, yet the stock cratered anyway. One analyst still sees a path to more than double from here, while others see a turnaround with no committed customers. Who is reading the data right?

items.title: This Is The Biggest Financial Risk, According To Fed's Report
items.summary: The Fed's survey of "salient risks" shows 87% of market participants identified AI as a major threat.

items.title: Why Is Intel Stock Falling 3.1% in Pre-Market Trading?
items.summary: Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) shares declined 3. 1% in pre-market trading on Tuesday, following reports that Nvidia had reduced its investment in the semiconductor manufacturer and amid shareholder lawsuits concerning Intel’s financial disclosures.

items.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of Intel (INTC) on Friday
items.summary: Intel (INTC) drew $28.3 million in net ETF selling last Friday.

items.title: Own Qualcomm? Your Stock Rides On Data Center Now
items.summary: Our Monday look, If Phone Sales Keep Shrinking, What Happens To Your Qualcomm Stock?, asked what a weaker phone market means for owners. The next question is the one owners really care about: what is the biggest risk now.

items.title: Risky Nvidia Is Cheaper Than 'Safe' Walmart
items.summary: Everyone knows the cast: Nvidia is the AI growth stock, and Walmart and Costco are the safe places to hide. Nvidia reports today, Tuesday, Nov 17, with its results call set for 2 p.m. Going in, the labels have swapped on one count that matters: price against next year's earnings.

items.title: Stocks to Watch: Nvidia, Deutsche Bank, Alibaba
items.summary: ↘️ Nvidia (NVDA): After a brief rally in after-hours trade, Nvidia shares are back in the red premarket as the company's board rebuffed efforts to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive.

items.title: Intel falls premarket as Nvidia cuts stake, SpaceX becomes top holding
items.summary: Investing.com -- Intel shares fell more than 3% in premarket trading Tuesday after Nvidia significantly trimmed its stake in the chipmaker.
